fuente.titulo: Pope Leo XIV’s “Freedom Under Grace” released in English

titular: Pope Leo XIV's book arrives in English
bajada: "Freedom Under Grace" gathers his reflections on St. Augustine's legacy
caption: Pope Leo XIV's book "Freedom Under Grace" has been released in English, compiling his reflections on St. Augustine, whose thought has long shaped his spirituality as an Augustinian friar. Source: Vatican News, Sept 15, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: A quiet library table with a new hardcover book resting under soft light, its cover facing up, placed in the upper right third; the left and central areas remain open and uncluttered.
